༄༅/ /skabs gsum ma'i ṭīk+ka rje'i dgongs gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skabs gsum ma'i ṭīk+ka rje'i dgongs gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/

sku gsum go 'phang mi zad mdzod brnyes nas/ /theg gsum gdul bya rigs can mtha' dag la/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo bskor nas re skong ba/ /srid gsum ston pa shākya sed+ger 'dud/ /rgyal ba'i mdo sngags lung rtogs bstan pa kun/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin 'dzin mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tsho yang dag dge ba'i bshes/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong kha pa der 'dud/ /mgon de'i legs bshad bstod tshig 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /blo gros snang ba'i zer gyis rab phye nas/ /don bzang snying po dad can rkang drug ldan/ /blo gsal dag gi dga' ston ched du spyin/ /de la 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa shākya'i rgyal bo'i bstod pa byin rlabs nyer 'jug ces bya ba rje nyid kyis mdzad pa 'di nyid kyi don 'chad pa la 'jug par bya ste/ /'di la bzhi/ mchod par brjod pa'i tshul gyis bstod yul ngos bzung ba/ bstod pa'i tshul bshad pa/ de dang 'brel ba'i thugs rgyud bskul ba/ mjug gi rim pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ 'jig rten gyi mthu bo che rnams kyis bkur tshul dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan brjod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ skabs gsum pa dang dbang po'i dgra /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ don ni skabs gsum pa zhes pa lha spyi'i ming yin kyang*/ 'dir lha rnams kyi gtso bo tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang nye dbang so gnyis sogs bzung zhing*/ dbang po'i dgra ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi dgra lha ma yin gyi gtso bo thag bzang ris sogs dang*/ dri za zhes pa ni dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung lta bu dang*/ gdengs can ni sprul gyi gdengs ka dang ldan pa'i klu'i rgyal po chen po brgyad dang mig mi bzang lta bu dang*/ grub pa ni kha cig grul bum la bshad kyang rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong chen po rnams te/ des mtshon te 'jig rten na mthu che bar grags pa'i gtso bo kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan nor bu yis/

thub dbang gang gi zhabs kyi pad+mo la gtugs pas mdzes par byas pa'o/ /lha la skabs gsum pa zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ kha cig des sngon las ji ltar bus lhar skyes pa dang*/ da lta gang du skyes pa dang*/ phyi ma gang du skye ba'i skabs gsum shes pa 'byung bas de ltar brjod pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig tu lha la skye ba dang gnas pa dang 'chi ba gsum yod pas de skad brjod ces byung ste gang rung ngo*/ /chos spyod 'ga' zhig tu dbang po'i sgra zhes sa mgo can du bris pa ni yig nor te/ lha min la dbang po'i dgra zhes pa'i tha snyad mngon brjod nas 'byung ba ltar mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gser 'od 'khyug pa'i dpal gyis brjed pa'i sku/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gcig ste/ 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser bzang btso ma'i mdangs lta bu dwangs shing gsal ba'i 'od zer 'khyug pa la sogs pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad gsal la rdzogs pa'i dpal gyis smras pa mdzes shing brjid pa'i sku'i yon tan dang*/ dri za'i rgyal po rab dgas pi wang rgyud stong sgrogs pa'i snyan pa'i glu dbyangs kyis bsgrun du nye 'gran du med pa'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yongs su rdzogs pa'i gsung gi yon tan dang*/ nyi ma bye ba'i mdangs lta bu'i gsal ba'i 'od kyis gzugs kyi bkod pa du ma ga la nus kyang ji ltar ji snyed chos kyi tshul rnams gsal mi nus pas/ de las kyang lhag pa shes bya'i rnam pa thams cad mngon sum du gsal bar gzigs pa'i thugs dang ldan cing*/ 'phrin las ni mtha' yas shing tshad med pa'i 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i sgo nas de'i 'dren pa'i mchog tu gyur pa'i shākya'i tog de la bstod do/ /shākya zhes pa ni rgya skad yin la de yang phod pa'am nus pa ste/ de'i rigs brgyud kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ bsam pa ji lta bus bstod pa/ spyod lam ji lta bus bstod pa/

bstod tshul dngos so/ /dang po ni/ dag pa'i zhing khams la shar ba'i gza' skar rnams zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ dper na/ sprin dang rdul sogs kyi sgrib byed kyis dag pa'i nam mkha' la shar ba'i zla ba sogs gza' dang skar ma rnams kyi gzugs brnyan ni chu gter rgya mtsho'i dbus na yongs su gsal bar shar ba bzhin du/ ma dad pa'i rnyog pa dang bral ba bstod pa po bdag gi dang ba'i yid kyi rgya mtshor khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan mdo dang bstan bcos chen po las bshad pa ltar gyi thos pa'i gzugs brnyan te don spyi rnams so sor ma 'dres shing gsal bar rab tu bkod pa ste dran pa'i sgo nas bstod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ dgongs gsol lo/ /dang po ni/ zla zer phog pa'i chu skyes zhes sogs rkang pa phyed bzhi ste/ dper na mtshan mo'i dus zla ba'i 'od zer phog pas chu skyes te pad+ma gzhon nu gsar ba'i kha zum par byed pa bzhin du/ bdag gi lag pa'i sor mo rnams snying kha'i ngos su zum pa ste thal mo sbyar nas/ ma g.yeng bar rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis ston pa khyod kyi sku mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum du zhugs par mos shing de la mngon du phyogs par byas te khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho'i ltar mang ba las cung zad cig blangs nas bstod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ thugs rje can khyod dgongs/ zhes pa ste/ de ltar cung zad bstod par 'gyur ba'i tshul 'di la ston pa thugs rje can khyod dgongs su gsol ba ste zhu ba'o/ /gsum pa bstod tshul dngos la gnyis/ yon tan gzhan dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas bstod pa'o/ /dang po la drug rgyal sras nyan rang rnams las khyad par du 'phags pa/ spyod lam mdzad tshul/ de mthong ba'i yon tan/ nus pa'i yon tan/ chags sdang med pa'i yon tan/ rtag tu 'gro don mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ skar ma'i tshogs kyis mkha' la zla ba bzhin/

zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ dper na/ skar ma'i tshogs rnams kyi nam mkha' la nya gang ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su bskor ba bzhin du/ ston pa khyod mi mthun phyogs 'joms pa la ye shes thogs med mnga' ba'i rgyal ba'i sras dpa' bo byams 'jam dbyangs sogs byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kun nas yongs su bskor zhing*/ ba lang gi khyu yi tshogs 'gro ba'i tshe thog mar khyu mchog gis sna drangs te 'gro ba bzhin du/ shā ri'i bu sogs nyan thos mchog brgyad la sogs pa dgra bcom pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs rnams kyis mdun du bdar ba ste bskor zhing bya ba byed do/ /khyu mchog ni ma he'am glang gi rigs can zhig yin te/ dbang phyug chen po'i bzhon pa'i khyu mchog ni glang du shes pas so/ /tshogs kyis zhes byed sgra 'byung ba ltar gshegs kyi/ kyi zhes drug pa'i sgra sbyar na ston pa nyid nyan thos tshogs kyi sngon du gshegs pa la bya ste phyi ma 'di dpe dang 'brel lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ nam mkha'i khyon kun 'gengs pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ ston pa khyod gshegs pa'i tshe nam mkha'i khyon kun 'gengs pa ste khyab pa'i 'od zer gyi dra ba stong gis te dpag tu med pas yongs su dkrigs pa ste bskor ba'i sku ni nam mkha'i lam nas rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul chen po sku stod nas me 'bar zhing sku smad nas chu 'khrugs pa dang*/ de las ldog pa dang*/ yang shar nas mi snang bar gyur te nub tu snang ba dang*/ nub nas mi snang zhing shar du snang ba la sogs pa phyogs bcur snang mi snang gi bkod pa sna tshogs dang gcig du ma dang du ma gcig tu 'gyur bar ston pa sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i cho 'phrul du ma bcas pa yi sgo nas/ dper na/ ngang ba'i rgyal po mkha' la 'phur ba bzhin du ston pa 'khor bcas rnams kyang nam mkha' la lding zhing gshegs par mdzad do/

/'di ni ston pa sangs rgyas nas yab dang mjal ba dang*/ ma ga dha bzang mos spyan drangs pa'i tshe cho 'phrul bstan pa dang sbyar ba gtso che ba ltar snang ngo*/ /gsum pa ni/ de tshe ring nas bskrun pa bzang po'i las/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ gshegs tshul de ltar mdzad pa'i tshe yun ring mo nas bskrun pa ste bsags pa'i dge 'bras bzang po 'byin pa'i las kyi 'bras bu yongs su sad pa ste smin pa'i lha dang mi stong phrag brgyas mtshon pa'i shin tu mang pos/ ston pa khyod kyi zhal mthong ba'i mod la de rnams kyi mi bsrun pa ste ma dul ba'i yid ni/ nyes pa brgyas mtshon pa'i shin tu mang pos bsdams pa'i 'ching ba dam po rnams ni kun nas lhod par gyur pa ste ci rigs spangs nas kha cig lam sna zin cing*/ gzhan dag bden pa mthong ba dang dgra bcom du gyur pa'o/ /bzhi pa la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ dpa' bo khyod kyis byang chub shing drung du/ /zhes rkang sogs pa bzhi ste/ mi mthun phyogs thams cad 'joms par byed nus pa'i dpa' bo khyod kyis sngon dka' spyad mdzad pa'i gnas byang chub shing gi drung du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rang gi 'od zer gyis bskul te bdud kyi dpung tshogs bar chad byed du lhags pa na ston pa khyod kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpung gis yid srub bdag po ste dge ba'i sems dkrugs par byed pa'i bdud dga' rab dbang phyug sde ste dpung bdud 'khor dang bcas pa'i dmag tshogs lus mi 'dra ba dang*/ skad sgra drag po mi 'dra ba sna tshogs dang ldan pa rnams kyis 'phangs pa'i mda' mdung ri phrag la sogs pa mtshon cha rnams me tog tu bsgyur ba sogs byas nas bdud kyi dpung ma lus pa rnams zil gyis gnon par mdzad pa ni/ dper na/ 'thor byed drag po'i rlung dang nye ba'i sprin nag po rlung gis gtor ba bzhin du de dag pham par byas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mda' mtshon go cha ma bzung bar/

/zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ mda' la sogs pa'i mtshon cha dang*/ khrab sogs go cha ma bzung zhing grogs dmag gi 'khor gzhan yod pa la ma bltos par rang nyid gcig pus byams pa'i stobs kyis bye bas mtshon pa'i bdud kyi dmag gi dpung rnams ma lus par pham par mdzad pa'i g.yul gyis las de lta bu khyod kyis mkhyen gyi/ khyod las gzhan pa'i sems can su yis de 'dra shes mi nus so/ /de ltar bdud pham par mdzad pa ni rgya cher rol pa sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin yin la/ 'on kyang tog gzungs las ston pas sangs rgyas nas ring por ma lon pa'i tshe yang bdud 'khor dang bcas pa'i dmag dpung sngar bzhin 'ong ba pham par mdzad pa zhig kyang bshad do/ /bdud kyi 'khor rnams bdud mtshan nyid pa yin pa shas che mod/ bdud kyis sangs rgyas kyi che ba 'don pas na bdud kyi rgyal po de ni dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo 'di dgongs pa la btags nas sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi sprul ba zhig yin gyi/ bdud dngos min par nges la/ tog gzungs nas kyang don gyis sprul ba yin par bstan snang ste thun mong ma yin pa'i go tshul lo/ /lnga pa ni/ de ltar khyod kyi byams pa'i mes/ zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ bshad ma thag pa de ltar ston pa khyod kyi byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pa'i mes 'dod pa'i lha gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po dga' rab dbang phyug sde dang bcas pa pham par mdzad pas/ 'dod lha 'khor bcas kyi snying ste yid ni rab tu gdungs shing mi dga' bar gyur kyang byams pa chen po dang brtse ba snying rje chen po'i gter du gyur pa khyod lus can gzhan phyogs bdud la sdang zhing mi dga' ba dang rang phyogs 'khor la chags shing zhen pa'i ris su chad pa'i chags sdang du gyur pa cung zad kyang med do/ /bdud kyi dpung gcig tsam min gyi/ stong gsum gzhan dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dag na'ang bdud kyi dpung yod par mdo las bshad cing tshe dpag med kyi zhing na bdud dang bdud kyi rigs med ces kyang bshad la/

der bdud mchod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba yod par bshad de de tshad dka' 'o/ /ston pas bdud bzhi bcom par ni rang la bdud bzhis gnod nus pa bcom pa yin gyi/ spyir bdud med par mdzad pa min te ston pa sangs rgyas nas kyang 'jig rten na bdud bzhi yod cing*/ med na mi ma yin gyi sems can kun med par 'gyur te zhib cha dgos so/ /drug pa ni/ khyod ni 'gro ba'i don gyi slad/ /ces sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ ston pa khyod ni thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa yin pa'i phyir 'gro ba sems can kun gyi don mdzad pa'i slad du dus cung zad tsam yang mi ngal zhing*/ rgyu mtshan des na 'gro ba rnams kyang ston pa khyod kyi yon tan brjod cing bstod pa dang gsol 'debs byed pa la ngal bar ma gyur pa ste brtson pa chen pos dus rgyun du ston pa khyod la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs par rigs so/ /zhes pa ni bskul ba'o/ /'dir mkhas pa kha cig ngal zhes pa ni ma dag pa kho na yin gyi/ mi dal zer dgos so zhes bshad la/ cang kya zhabs kyis mi ngal zhes pa'i don du 'chad par mdzad do/ /da lta kha cig snga ma la mi ngal zhes dang*/ phyi ma la dal ma gyur zhes khyad par byas nas 'don no/ /kho bo ltar na de gnyis gcig tu 'gro bar snang ste/ skyo ngal med par sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang ston pa'i yon tan brjod pa dang*/ mi dal mi lhod par sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang ston pa'i yon tan brjod pa gnyis gnad gcig tu 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ sku gsum thugs kyi yon tan brjod pa dngos/ de gsum gyi 'phrin las lhub grub tu mdzad pa/ yon tan gyi khyad par rnams rdzogs par rtogs nas brjod mi nus par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgya mtsho'i klong ltar rab tu zab pa'i thugs/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po'i klong ste gting mtha' zab cing rgya che ba'i tshad ni tha mal bas ji lta ba bzhin gzhal mi nus pa ltar/

mkhyen pa dang brtse ba rgya mtsho lta bu'i gting mtha' rab tu zab cing rgya che ba gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i thugs kyi yon tan dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum na lha rnams bag med kyi spyod pa las bzlog ste bag yod la bskur par byed pa'i lha'i rnga bo che zhes bya ba gzhan gyis bskul ba la ma bltos par rang shugs kyis chos kyi sdom bzhi ston pa'i rang sgra dus dus su 'byung ba bzhin du/ 'bad pa med par gdul bya rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i dam po'i chos legs par 'doms pa'i gsung gi yon tan dang*/ dper na ri rab lhun po'i dpangs kyi spo mtho zhing ri gzhan las 'phags pa ltar/ 'khor gser ri lta bu grangs med pa'i dbus na ston pa khyod kyi sku mtho gsal mdzes pas mngon par 'phags shing*/ de ltar bu'i sku de gdul bya sus mthong ba dang gsung thos pa dang thugs kyi yon tan dran pa tsam gyis kyang phan pa dang bde ba'i don chen po ldan par mdzad do/ /'dir cung zad phye ste bshad na sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi yon tan mkhyen brtse gnyis las/ mkhyen pa la rnams mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya dang bcu'am/ zag med kyi yon tan brgya zhe bzhi yod cing de yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gnyis las dang po ni sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi dran pa nyer gzhag sogs dang*/ phyi ma ni stobs bcu la sogs pa'o/ /der ma zad thar chen las stobs re re la'ang stobs dpag tu med par bshad de gzhan la'ang 'dra'o/ /mkhyen pa rnams ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa gnyis su 'du zhing ji lta ba mkhyen pa rnams ni gnas lugs zab mo rtogs pa'i sgo nas zab pa dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa rnams ni shes bya ji snyed pa'i ngo bo dang rnam pa dang rab dbye so sor mkhyen pa'i sgo nas rgya che bar 'jog cing*/ brtse ba dmigs yul sems can mtha' yas la dmigs pa'i sgo nas dmigs pa rgya che bar 'jog go

/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas kyi ji ltar ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad tsam yin gyi 'gal ba min no/ /shes bya mkhyen tshul ni/ byams mgon gyis mdo sde'i rgyan las/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gcig btang bas/ 'gro ba snang ba byed pa ltar/ de bzhin shes bya thams cad la/ sangs rgyas ye shes cig car snang*/ /zhes dang*/ bden gnyis las kyang*/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig gis ni/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / gsung gi yon tan la 'bad rtsol med par gdul bya la chos ston pa'i dpe ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ ji ltar lha nang lha rnams las/ /sngon gyi dkar po'i mthu yis ni/ /'bad dang gnas dang yid gzugs dang*/ /rnam par rtog pa med bzhin du/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang*/ /zhi ba'i sgra yi bag med pa'i/ /lha rnams thams cad yang dang yang*/ /chos kyi rngas ni bskul ba ltar/ /de bzhin khyab bdag 'bad sogs dang*/ /bral yang 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi khyab mdzad cing*/ /skal ldan rnams la chos ston to/ /zhes dang*/ rgyud bla ma las kyang*/ ji ltar rnga ni ma brdungs par/ /sgra ni kun tu 'byung ba ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal ba bzo med par/ /bshad pa dag ni kun tu 'byung*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gsung gi mtha' rtogs par dka' ste/ 'phags pa mo'u 'gal gyi bus sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi mtha' 'tshol ba'i ched du rdzun 'phrul gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag brgya 'das par song yang sangs rgyas kyi gsung che chung drung na bzhugs pa dang khyad par med par thos pa dang*/ sku yang de bzhin te byang chub sems dpa' sprin gyi shugs 'chang zhes bya bas sangs rgyas kyi dbu'i gtsug tor gyi mtha' 'tshol ba'i phyir steng phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag bcu 'das par song yang gtsug tor gyi mtha' ma mthong ba lta bu'o/

/gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten khams kyi sems can thams cad kyis/ /zhes sogs rkang ba lnga ste/ de lta bu'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa khyod la brtag pa mtha' bzung du gal te 'jig rten gyi khams kun na yod pa'i sem can thams cad kyis/ dus snga phyi ma yin par dus gcig nyid du the tshom gyi dri ba mi 'dra ba re re'i don so sor zhus kyang*/ sems can de dag re re'i mdun du'ang de snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i sku'i bkod pa mi 'dra ba re re'i dus gcig tu bstan nas/ lan la gsung gi chos ston pa'i tshul mi 'dra ba'i bkod pa re res dus gcig mdzad par nus shing*/ de ltar mdzad kyang thugs la sku'i 'phrul 'di ltar bya'o snyam pa'i rtog pa dang*/ gsung gis lan 'di ltar bya'o snyam pa'i 'bad rtsol dang bcas pa'i rtog pa nye bar zhi ba yin te/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las rnams 'bad rtsol med par yid bzhin nor bu dang dpag bsam gyi shing dang bum pa bzang po las 'dod don 'byung ba bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ /mtshan brjod las/ yid bzhin nor bu chen po 'chang*/ /khyab bdag rin chen kun gyi mchog /dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa ste/ /bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog /byed pa sems can kun don byed/ ces dang*/ dbu ma 'jug pa las kyang*/ ji ltar rdza mkhan stobs chen ldan pas 'dir/ /yun ring ches 'bad pas bskor 'khor lo ni/ de'i rtsol da lta skyes pa med bzhin du'ang*/ 'khor zhing bum pa la sogs rgyur mthong ltar/ de bzhin da lta skyes rtsol med bzhin du/ chos kyi bdag can sku nyid la zhugs de'i/ 'jug pa'i skye bo'i dge dang smon lam gyi/ khyad par gyis 'phangs las ches bsam mi khyab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sku'i cho 'phrul ston tshul gyi khyad par mdo gzhan las kyang mang du bshad cing*/ sa bcu pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i don bsdus nas dbu ma 'jug par/ dang po'i thugs bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/

/de dag spyod kun dngos rnams mig 'phrul gyi/ /rang bzhin mkhyen pas bdag bzhin ba spu yi/ /khung bu dus gcig la ni gsal bar ston/ /de bzhin dus gsum byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang rgyal 'phags pa nyan thos ma lus kyi/ /spyod dang de lhag skye bo'i gnas skabs ni/ /thams cad ba spu'i khung bur gcig tshe ston/ /dag pa 'di ni bzhed pa 'jug pa yi/ /rdul gcig yul la mkha' gtugs 'jig rten dang*/ /'jig rten mtha' yas phyogs khyab rdul ston mod/ /zhes gsungs te rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'dra'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi sku dngos ni ye shes kyi bdag nyid can gyi sku yin pas khong stong dang rtsa rgyus nang khrol sogs med de/ rim lnga las/ khong stong khyod kyi sku la med/ /ces gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /ston pa'i sku gser gang bu lta bu yin pa sogs sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum gyi khyad par ni gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las phyag rdor gyis rgyas par bshad cing*/ rjes bstod sprin rgya mtsho las kyang*/ de dang mthun par gsungs te sku'i yon tan mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis spras pa dang*/ gsung gi yon tan yan lag drug cu mnga' ba ni grags che la/ gsung gis 'gro ba du ma la chos ston pa'i tshe sang skri ta'i skad lta bu gcig gsungs pa na gzhan skad rigs mi mthun pa rnams kyis rang rang gi skad dang mthun par go bar 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ gsung gcig nyid kyis gsungs mod kyi/ /du ma nyid du so sor go /zhes dang*/ mang po dag gis dus gcig zhu zhus kyang*/ /de dag skad cig gcig la thugs chud nas/ /gsung dbyangs gcig gis so sor lan kyang 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang so so yang dag rig pa bzhi mthar phyin pa rnams kyis ni lha klu mi sogs kyi skad rigs mi 'dra ba thams cad mkhyen cing brjod pa yin te/

ji skad du/ lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang*/ /'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ci tsam pa/ /thams cad skad du bdag gis chos ston to/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ /rdzogs par rtogs dka' ba dang*/ /rdzogs par brjod dka' ba'o/ /dang po ni/ khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba yi/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ ston pa khyed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba yi yon tan gyi gnas tshul 'di ni rdzogs par ji lta ba bzhin brjod dka' ba yin te/ rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' dang rang rgyal dang nyan thos 'phags pa rnams kyis kyang gnas tshul de la ji tsam brtags kyang ji lta ba bzhin blo'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul du 'gyur ba ma yin na/ tshangs pa dang lha'i dbang po brgya byin sogs 'jig rten na che bar grags pa rnams dang gzhan gyis mngon sum du rtogs pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal ba ste mi shes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkha' lding dbang pos mkha' la bgrod bgrod nas/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ dper na nam mkha' lding gi dbang po gshog rtsal che yang des nam mkha'i mtha' nyul ba'i ched du nam mkha' de la bgrod bgrod kyang nam zhig na rang gi lus kyi rtsal stobs bri bas te zad nas rang gnas su ldog par 'gyur gyi/ nam mkha'i mtha' zad pas bgrod sa ma rnyed par ldog par mi 'gyur ba bzhin du/ byang sems nyan rang 'jig rten pa sogs kyis kyang khyod kyi yon tan gyi mtha' rdzogs par brjod mi nus pa'ang de ltar sogs te/ dpal ldan zla bas dbu ma 'jug pa las/ nam mkha' med pas 'dab chags ldog par mi 'gyur gyi/ /'dir ni rang mthu zad pas ldog par 'gyur de bzhin/ /slob ma dang bcas sangs rgyas sras rnams sangs rgyas kyi/ /yon tan mkha' ltar mtha' yas ma brjod ldog par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'dir 'grel pa 'ga' las brjod mi nus pa'i gang zag gong gi byang sems nyan rang sogs la ma sbyar bar brjod pa po rang nyid lta bu tsam la sbyar ba ni skabs don min snyam mo/

/gsum pa la gsum/ bstod pa po yon tan khyad par can med cing skyon dang bcas nas nyam thag tshul/ de ltar nyam thag pa yal bar mi 'dor bar rjes su 'dzin dgos shing mi 'dzin na sngon dam bcas pa dgos pa med tshul/ de lta na'ang rang nyid skyon dang bcas shing ston pa skyon med du bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gshog rtsal rab tu rdzogs pa'i mkha' lding gis/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis te/ dper na gshog pa'i rtsal la rab tu rdzogs pa'i nam mkha' lding gi rgyal pos nam mkhar bgrod pa'i lam ste shul du gshog rtsal nyam chung ba'i byi'u kyang bgrod pa'i rtsol ba byed pa ltar/ mkha' lding lta bu'i stobs bcu mnga' ba'i ston pa khyod go 'phang mchog gang du gshegs pa'i lam mchog der ni 'jug par 'dod pa'i bstod pa po byi'u lta bu bdag cag ni/ yon tan gyi ngos nas gnas lugs stong nyid zab mo'i don la lta ba'i blo gros kyi mig nyams shing*/ nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems sogs kyi yon tan gyi 'byor pas kyang dbul la/ skyon phyogs nas bzlog dka' ba'i stobs ldan chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i dgra bos ni rgyun du gtses pa ste gnod/ gang zag dang chos kyi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gcong rong zab mo'i sbubs su ni lhung bar gyur lags so/ /skyon brjod pa 'di ni rang cag gdul bya phyis 'byung gi gsol 'debs byed pa rnams la dgongs kyi mkhas pa kha cig rje rang nyid kho na la sbyar snang ba ni don cung min nam snyam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'di 'dra'i nyam thag gnas su gyur lags na/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig te/ ji skad bshad pa 'di 'dra ba'i nyam thag pa'i gnas su gyur lags pa bdag cag brtse ba snying rje chen po'i gter chen ston pa khyod kyis rjes su 'dzin pa 'os shing*/ gal te mi 'dzin par yal bar 'dor ba mdzad lags na ni 'o na dman pa bdag cag rnams la ches cher brtse ba'i mgon skyabs ston pa khyod las lhag gzhan pa gang la skyabs su gzung bar bya ste de 'dra mi srid do/

/gsum pa ni/ snyigs ma lnga yi ha cang sbags pa yi/ /zhes sogs tshig bcad gnyis te/ de ltar yal bar 'dor na ni da lta'i sems can tshe thung bas tshe snyigs ma/ nyon mongs che bas nyon mongs snyigs ma/ bsod nams chung zhing 'dul dka' bas sems can snyigs ma/ lta bas dman pas lta ba snyigs ma/ dus mar 'grib drug cu kha ral gyi skabs su song bas dus snyigs ma ste snyigs ma lnga yis ha cang sbags che ba yi zhing 'di ni/ khyod sngon 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu 'khyud kyi 'dun na 'don bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul du gyur pa'i tshe/ grogs gzhan rnams kyis sangs rgyas rin chen snying po'i drung du rang rang gis dag pa'i zhing re 'dzin pa'i smon lam btab pa ltar lung bstan nas/ ma dag pa'i zhing 'di 'dzin pa spangs pa'i dus su mgon po khyod kyis yongs su bzung ste dam bca'i smon lam mdzad pa na/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyis rgyal sras gzhan rnams la pad+ma lta bu dang*/ khyod ni pad+ma gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i pad+ma dkar po lta bu'o/ /zhes bsngags shing legs so zhes brjod pa'i dgos pa'ang ci zhig yod de dgos pa med pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ /de lta na snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus kyi sems can rnams 'dul dka' ba yin mod kyi 'on kyang ston pa thugs rje can khyod kyis gdul bya yal bar 'dor mi srid de/ khyod kyi 'phrin las mdzad pa la gdul bya snod dang ldan mi ldan dang dus la bab ma bab sogs ma brtags par yal bar 'dor ba'i btang snyoms su 'jog pa'i skyon cung zad kyang khyod la mi mnga' bas snod du rung zhing dus la babs na ni kun gyi don mdzad pa'i phyir te/ don mi mdzad par re zhig btang snyoms su 'jog dgos pa byung ba ni skal pa ngan pa bdag cag gi nyes pa'i skyon kho nar zad pa'i phyir te/ rgyu mtshan de ltar yin pa de'i phyir ston pa khyod la gzhan don mi byed ces pa'i skyon 'jug pa'i skabs med pa'i phyir ro/

/bzhi pa la gnyis/ mjug gi smon lam dang*/ mdzad byang ngo*/ /dang po ni/ de nas byang chub snying bor bdud sde las/ /zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa gcig ste/ ston pa khyod la skyon de lta bu med pas na dus deng nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po'i shing drung du gnas te bdud kyi sde las ji srid rgyal bar ma gyur pa'i dus de srid du yang yang skye zhing skye bar 'gyur ba'i skye ba thams cad du khyod kyis rjes su bzung nas/ legs par bshad pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung bas ngoms pa med par shog cig ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa mdzad byang ni/ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes sogs te/ de bzhin nyid la slar mi ldang ba'i tshul gyis gshegs shing mnyam par bzhag pas de bzhin gshegs pa/ nyon mongs pa spangs pas dgra bcom pa/ spangs rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs pas yang dag par rdzogs pa/ ma rig pa sangs shing shes bya la blo rgyas pas sangs rgyas/ shes rab kyi bslab pa'am rig pa gsum dang ldan pas rig pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba'am tshul khrims dang bsam gtan dang ldan pas zhabs su ldan pa/ spangs rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i go 'phang dam par gshegs pas na bde bar gshegs pa/ snod bcud kun dang gdul bya'i khams ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pas 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ gdul bya'i skyes bu thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas 'dul bas skyes bu 'dul ba/ yang dag pa'i lam la 'khrid pas kha lo bsgyur ba/ de'i gong na mchog tu gyur pa gzhan med pas bla na med pa/ lha dang mi sogs la blang dor ji lta ba bzhin ston pas ston pa ste gzhan ni go sla'o/ /bstod pa 'di bskul ba po rje nyid kyi slob ma rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho yin la/ de yang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis rtogs ldan pa la khyed kyis rje la bstod pa 'di rtsom par bskul zhig ces gsungs pa gor ma chags te/

bstod pa 'di phyogs thams cad du dar zhing khyab par ma zad 'di gdangs byas nas ton pa na blo dman kho bo cag lta bu la yang gzhon dus nas ston pa la dad gus khyad par can skyes te mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs pa dang*/ lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba sogs lan du mar 'byung gi bstod pa gzhan 'don pa'i tshe de lta bu'i dad gus khyad par can mi skye ba'i phyir dang*/ ji skad du/ gzhan yang dben gnas du mar 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /'di dang 'di 'dra'i bstan bcos rtsoms shig dang*/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa 'byung ngo zhes/ /gsungs nas bka' bzhin mdzad pa'i btsong kha pa/ /zhes 'byung ba'i don khyad par can bstod pa 'di la legs par tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /smras pa/ rgyal ba gnyis par grags pa'i btsong kha pas/ /lha mi'i ston pa shākya'i tog gyur de'i/ /yon tan brjod pa'i bstod tshig phreng mdzes 'di/ /skal bzang yongs kyi mgul ba'i rgyan du spel/ /gang 'di'i dgongs don rgya mtsho'i yid bzhin nor/ /legs bshad rgyal mtshan rtse mor mngon mchod de/ /don bzang 'dod rgu'i char chen 'bebs byed kyis/ blo gsal don gnyer can dag 'dus shig kye/ /'dir 'bad dge legs kun da'i gnyen gyur te/ /skye kun lha mi'i rten bzang rnyed pa dang*/ /thub dbang nyid kyis brtse bas rjes bzung ste/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus 'dzin gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni sngar bstod pa 'di'i ṭīk+ka cung rgyas tsam ni bris yod pa par du brko 'dod kyang*/ bor nas ma rnyed pas slar yang 'grel pa 'di nyid shākya'i dge slong grags par bshad sgrub ces bya bas rang lo re brgyad thog co na'i dgon nyid du dad pas sbyar ba ste/ par gyi yi ge pa ni dge slong kun dga' nor bu'o/ /'phags pa skyabs kyis brkos pa'o// //mad+ga laṃ/
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/skabs gsum ma'i ṭīk+ka rje'i dgongs gsal sgron me bzhugs/ -PAGE 332--PAGE 333--PAGE 315-
